templates.useFor: If you want to use this style for other characters
templates.prompt: A high-quality historical oil painting of [INSERT SUBJECT NAME] standing formally. The image is designed as a YouTube thumbnail with modern graphic overlays. A jagged red paint stroke in the top left corner contains the word "Why?" in bold white text. A red sketched arrow points specifically to [INSERT DETAIL, e.g., their hand/pocket/hat]. The lighting is museum-quality.

templates.useFor: Use this to apply the same collage and red-hand style to different subjects
templates.prompt: A conceptual editorial illustration in the style of a Vox Future Perfect graphic. The central subject is a grayscale, vintage-style illustration of a [INSERT SUBJECT, e.g., mechanical engine / human brain / city skyline], which has been cut into four distinct sections. Four large, red-gloved hands enter the frame from the corners, each pointing with an index finger at one of the subject's sections. The background is a technical blueprint schematic with faint white lines, circles, and schematics, overlaid with subtle, aged paper textures. The overall aesthetic is a collage of diagrammatic and graphic design elements.

templates.useFor: Use this to apply the same blueprint and yellow highlight style to different subjects
templates.prompt: A technical line drawing illustration in the style of a Vox video thumbnail. Against a solid dark grey background, white serif text at the top reads "[INSERT TITLE, e.g., The new rocket / A nuclear reactor]". Below it is a clean, white outline blueprint of a [INSERT SUBJECT, e.g., spacecraft / power plant]. One specific, crucial section of the [INSERT SUBJECT], such as the [INSERT SPECIFIC PART, e.g., booster engine / cooling tower], is filled in with a solid, bright yellow color. This yellow section has a thin red outline and a red dashed line indicating a path or area beneath or around it. The white "Vox" logo is in the bottom left corner. The style is clean, informational, and schematic.

templates.useFor: Use this for dramatic financial or personal transformation comparisons
templates.prompt: A dramatic split-screen YouTube thumbnail comparison with a sharp diagonal divider. The left half is dark, moody, and desaturated, showing [INSERT SUBJECT DESCRIPTION] looking despondent, dressed casually (e.g., black t-shirt), looking down with a hand on their chin. The background is a dim, blurred office. At the top left, a black rounded rectangular graphic displays a red down-arrow icon and red text "[INSERT NEGATIVE NUMBER/TEXT, e.g., -90 Cr]". The right half is bathed in bright, warm, golden light, showing the same [INSERT SUBJECT DESCRIPTION] smiling broadly, looking up triumphantly, dressed formally (e.g., black blazer). The background is luxurious and glowing. At the top right, a black rounded rectangular graphic displays a yellow up-arrow icon and yellow text "[INSERT POSITIVE NUMBER/TEXT, e.g., 600 Cr]". A subtle line graph overlay trends down on the left and sharply up on the right. The white "[INSERT LOGO NAME, e.g., GrowthX]" logo is in the bottom left corner.

templates.useFor: Use this for chronological or technological evolution comparisons
templates.prompt: A three-panel vertical split-screen YouTube thumbnail illustrating an evolution. Left Panel (Past): A desaturated, black and white historical photograph of [INSERT SUBJECT 1, e.g., a historical figure or early technology]. The background is an industrial or historical setting (e.g., a factory). At the top, there is a rectangular box with a solid [INSERT COLOR 1, e.g., YELLOW] background and bold black text "[INSERT TITLE 1, e.g., OIL]". Middle Panel (Present): A modern, full-color photograph of [INSERT SUBJECT 2, e.g., a contemporary figure or current technology]. The background is a modern office or home setting. At the top, there is a rectangular box with a solid [INSERT COLOR 2, e.g., BLUE] background and bold white text "[INSERT TITLE 2, e.g., INTERNET]". Right Panel (Future): A futuristic, digital illustration of [INSERT SUBJECT 3, e.g., a robot or future concept]. The background is an abstract, glowing digital grid or futuristic landscape. At the top, there is a rectangular box with a solid [INSERT COLOR 3, e.g., WHITE] background and bold black text "[INSERT TITLE 3, e.g., AI]". The white "GrowthX" logo is in the bottom left corner. The overall style is clean and uses distinct color coding for each era.

templates.useFor: Use this for financial data, market share, or statistical breakdowns
templates.prompt: A professional financial infographic illustration in the style of The Wall Street Journal's "The Economics Of" series. The background is a textured, light greenish-grey paper, resembling currency or high-quality newsprint. In the center is a large, textured pie chart representing [INSERT TOPIC, e.g., Smartphone Market Share / Global Oil Reserves]. The chart is divided into distinct sections colored in stippled, grainy shades of [INSERT COLORS, e.g., red, emerald green, and teal]. Floating rounded rectangular labels containing text like "[INSERT LABEL 1, e.g., Apple]" and "[INSERT LABEL 2, e.g., Samsung]" point to specific slices with thin black lines. At the top, a clean white banner contains the bold black headline "[INSERT TITLE TEXT]". Large white percentage numbers are visible on the chart slices. The bottom features the elegant serif text "The Economics of".

templates.useFor: Use this for geopolitical explainers, military strategy maps, or regional conflict visualizations
templates.prompt: A geopolitical data visualization map in the style of "WSJ Explains". The background is a dark, muted grey base map of [INSERT REGION, e.g., Eastern Europe / South China Sea]. Entity 1 (Blue): Countries belonging to [INSERT GROUP 1 NAME, e.g., NATO / Allies] are highlighted in solid bright blue. A black label box with white text reads "[INSERT LABEL 1]". Entity 2 (Red): The opposing territory of [INSERT GROUP 2 NAME, e.g., Russia / Opposing Force] is highlighted in solid bright red. A black label box with white text reads "[INSERT LABEL 2]". Conflict Elements: Along the border between the two zones, there are several glowing orange circular markers indicating [INSERT KEY LOCATIONS, e.g., strategic bases / hotspots]. Dashed orange lines connect these points. Movement: Multiple stylized icons of [INSERT ASSETS, e.g., fighter jets / naval ships / missiles], colored in glowing orange and red, are depicted flying/moving from the red zone towards the blue zone. Branding: In the bottom left corner, large white serif text reads "WSJ | EXPLAINS".

templates.useFor: Use this for international agreements, loans, or financial comparisons between two nations
templates.prompt: A professional informational graphic in the style of "WSJ Explains" for a financial topic. The background is a textured, dark grey chalkboard surface. Central Figure: In the center, large, bold, white sans-serif text reads "[INSERT AMOUNT, e.g., $50 MILLION / €10 BILLION]". Left Side: On the left, a flag on a pole represents [INSERT COUNTRY 1 NAME]. Right Side: On the right, a flag on a pole represents [INSERT COUNTRY 2 NAME]. Currency Elements: Above the central text, a stack of [INSERT CURRENCY 1 NAME, e.g., Japanese Yen] banknotes is visible. Below the central text, a stack of [INSERT CURRENCY 2 NAME, e.g., US Dollars] banknotes is visible. Connection: A dashed white line forms a large loop connecting the flags and both stacks of currency, encircling the central text. Branding: In the bottom left corner, large white serif text reads "WSJ | EXPLAINS".
